items.quote: BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce's REST APIs: store-level credentials, app-level credentials, and account-level credentials.
items.why: Quote confirms OAuth-based API accounts; bearer_token is not mentioned.

items.quote: Merchants generate single-store API credentials when they create API accounts in their store control panel, in the Settings > Store-level API accounts menu.
items.why: Quote says merchants generate credentials in the control panel; says nothing about approval.

items.quote: Sandbox stores are intended for developing and testing apps. They cannot process any live transactions.
items.why: Quote is about sandbox stores not processing live transactions; unrelated to credential gating.

items.quote: To create an account-level API account visit the account control panel or the store control panel for a member store at Settings > Account-level API accounts.
items.why: Quote only describes where to create account-level API accounts; no REST/GraphQL/webhook breadth.

items.quote: The docs site exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that AI tools can search and reference.
items.why: Docs site exposes an MCP server, stated by the vendor's own docs, so existence and official status hold. URL not in quote.

items.quote: If you're looking for an MCP server that interacts with your storefront, see the BigCommerce MCP Server.
items.why: Confirms a vendor-named BigCommerce MCP Server exists, but it is a storefront server, not clearly the docs server.
